issuer: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
printed_title: ALMM - No blanket extension of ALMM List-II (for solar PV cells) subject to limited window to Net-Metering / Open Access projects till 31st December 2026

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: Earlier this dispensation for Net-metering projects and Open Access renewable power projects was available till 31st May 2026. Net- metering projects and Open Access renewable power projects commissioned after 31st December, 2026, will be required to comply with the ALMM List-ll provisions.
candidate_clauses.topic: Net-metering/OA exemption from List-II extended 31.05.2026 -> 31.12.2026; supersedes OM 25.05.2026 and four June 2026 OMs

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: no blanket extension of the ALMM deadline, i.e., 1st June 2026, will be given.
